app.title: Slab
app.subtitle: PDF, sharpened.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Make Slab look like home. Changes apply instantly.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.desc: Choose Slab's interface language. Restart not required.
settings.theme.title: Theme
settings.theme.desc: Choose Slab's appearance. Auto follows your operating system's day/night setting.
settings.accent.title: Accent
settings.accent.desc: Highlight colour for buttons, links, and the current-page indicator.
settings.density.title: Density
settings.density.desc: Spacing throughout the shell. Pick Compact on small screens or when you want more on the page.
settings.vim.title: Vim bindings
settings.vim.desc: Modal keyboard navigation across the Reader, Library and Beacon. Experimental — press Esc any time to return to Normal mode.
settings.onboarding.title: Onboarding
settings.onboarding.desc: Replay the welcome tour. Useful after an update or to show a colleague what Slab does.
settings.search.title: Search
settings.search.desc: Atlas full-text search across every PDF in your library. Powered by SQLite FTS5 — entirely offline, sub-100ms on typical libraries. Snippet length and result cap live in ~/.slab/config.toml under [library.search].
settings.search.hint.privacy: Your queries never leave this machine.
vim.enabled.detail: Press Esc anytime to return to Normal mode.
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.subtitle: Drop a plugin into ~/.slab/plugins to extend Slab with themes, languages, custom commands, AI providers, and PDF actions.
plugins.empty.title: No plugins installed
plugins.empty.body: Plugins live at ~/.slab/plugins. Each plugin is a folder containing plugin.toml. See PLUGINS.md for the manifest format.
plugins.browse.empty.title: No plugins published yet
plugins.browse.empty.body: The Slab plugin marketplace is empty right now. Check back soon — or contribute your own at the slab-plugins repo.
plugins.browse.author: by {author}
plugins.browse.sort.name: Name (A–Z)
plugins.browse.noMatches.title: No plugins match those filters
plugins.browse.noMatches.body: Try a different search term, clear the category, or hit Refresh to pull the latest index.
plugins.browse.embeddedSeed: Showing built-in starter plugins — connect to the internet to browse the full marketplace.
plugins.browse.hero.title: Welcome to the Plugin Store
plugins.browse.hero.body: Slab ships with three example plugins so you can see the runtime in action. Open one to peek at its source, or browse below for community plugins.
plugins.notify.browserOnly: Marketplace is only available in the Slab desktop app
plugins.installed.bundled_tooltip: Ships with Slab — seeded on first launch. Safe to disable, safe to uninstall (it'll come back on a fresh install).
plugins.uninstallConfirm.title: Uninstall {name}?
plugins.uninstallConfirm.body: This removes the plugin files from your machine. You can reinstall it from the marketplace at any time.
plugins.consent.title: Permissions for {name}
plugins.consent.subtitle: Choose what this plugin is allowed to do. Defaults are the most restrictive option the plugin can still run with.
plugins.consent.permission.fs.desc: Read or write files on your machine.
plugins.consent.permission.net.desc: Make HTTP requests to other servers.
plugins.consent.permission.beacon.desc: Register AI providers or chat tools.
plugins.consent.allowHosts.label: Allowed hosts
plugins.consent.allowPaths.label: Allowed paths
plugins.consent.noRuntime: This plugin doesn't run code — no permissions needed.
plugins.consent.notify.reset: Permissions for {name} cleared — you'll be asked again on next enable
settings.theater.title: Theater
settings.theater.desc: Present any PDF as slides — fullscreen on a second display, laser pointer, ink overlay, blackout. Press and hold the shortcut to start.
settings.theater.hint.customize: Rebind any of these in Keymap below.
onboarding.theater.title: Present from any document
onboarding.theater.body: Hit ⇧⌘P (or Ctrl+Shift+P on Windows/Linux) on any open PDF to enter Theater — audience window on your second display, presenter panel with timer, notes, ink, and laser on your laptop.
onboarding.theater.hint: Esc exits Theater; B blacks out; I toggles the pen.
settings.ai.heading: AI / Beacon
settings.ai.subhead: Powers Smart Fill, summaries, search, and chat. Defaults to local Ollama — nothing leaves your machine.
settings.ai.apiKeyEnvDesc: Name of the environment variable holding your key. We never store the key itself.
quill.smartfill.heroTitle: Drop a source. Drop a form. Magic.
quill.smartfill.heroSub: Slab's local AI reads the source, finds matching fields on the target form, and proposes a fill you can review row-by-row. Nothing leaves your machine.
